final: WITH pc AS (SELECT p.bats AS bats, pa.player_id AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats), hand AS (SELECT bats, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM pc GROUP BY bats), overall AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS grand FROM hand), shares AS (SELECT h.bats AS bats, h.total AS total, CAST(h.total AS REAL) / o.grand AS share FROM hand h CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.grand IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_s FROM shares) SELECT s.bats, s.total, s.share, s.share - a.avg_s AS share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_s ORDER BY s.bats
